visual.general_description: Table of demographics, ingested drugs, manifestations and severity score for four pediatric clonazepam poisoning cases.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background table titled Table 1 with seven columns (Cases, Age, Sex, Underlying conditions, Type and dosage of ingested drugs, Clinical manifestations, PSS) and four data rows for cases 1 to 4, separated by horizontal rules above and below the header and below the last row. Case 1 row prints 13 years 1 month, Female, Moderate depression, Clonazepam (∼10 tablets) Lithium carbonate (8 tablets), Weakness, limb tremors, altered consciousness, dizziness, and nausea, and 2. Case 2 prints 11 years 2 months, Female, Severe depression, Clonazepam (70 tablets), Gait instability and 1. Case 3 prints 1 year 7 months, Male, None, Clonazepam, specific dose unknown, Unsteady standing, mild ptosis, and slurred speech and 1. Case 4 prints 1 year 2 months, Female, None, Clonazepam, specific dose unknown, Gait instability, agitation, intermittent crying, and restlessness and 2. A footer prints PSS: Pediatric Severity Score. No photograph, face, identifier, panel letter or arrow is present.

visual.general_description: Table of clonazepam blood levels at admission and after treatment with theoretical and actual elimination times for four cases.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background table titled Table 2 with five columns (Case; Clonazepam blood level at admission (μg/L); Clonazepam level after treatment (μg/L); Theoretical elimination time (h); Actual elimination time (h)) and four data rows. Case 1 prints 165.0, 53.9, 66.6–195.4 and 10.5. Case 2 prints 236.9, 119.5, 40.7–118.7 and 8. Cases 3 and 4 print 162.8 and 32.8 at admission and a dash in each of the other three columns. A footer prints TDM: therapeutic drug monitoring. No photograph, face, identifier, panel letter, curve or arrow is present.

visual.general_description: Table of ingested drugs, time to gastric lavage, flumazenil, treatment measures, hospital stay and outcome for four cases.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background table titled Table 3 with seven columns (Case; Ingested drugs; Time from ingestion to gastric lavage (h); Antidote (flumazenil); Treatment measures; Length of hospital stay (days); Outcome) and four data rows. Case 1 prints Clonazepam lithium carbonate, ∼ 15, Flumazenil (0.2 mg, Intravenous injection, once), Hemoperfusion (3.5 h) Symptomatic and supportive treatment, 3 and Recovered. Case 2 prints Clonazepam, ∼ 4, a dash, Hemoperfusion + CVVH (48 h) Symptomatic and supportive treatment, 3 and Recovered. Case 3 prints Clonazepam, ∼ 1.5, Flumazenil (0.11 mg, Intravenous injection, once), Symptomatic and supportive treatment, 4 and Recovered. Case 4 prints Clonazepam, ∼ 1, a dash, Symptomatic and supportive treatment, 5 and Recovered. A footer prints CVVH: continuous venovenous hemofiltration. No photograph, face, identifier, panel letter or arrow is present.
